title: Contract phase gates and SKU mapping to MSA/DPA liability profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement an automated gate and SKU-to-liability mapping system that ties product SKUs/pricing tiers to allowable MSA/DPA liability and indemnity profiles. This enables sales to complete a preflight check during quotes, auto-surface required legal concessions, and allow fast-track approvals for lower-risk SKUs while routing higher-risk deals to Legal. The work spans policy definition, UX changes in the quote/sales flow, contract redline automation hooks, and telemetry for pricing experiments.
acceptance_criteria: SKU catalog extended with liability profile field and tenant-visible tier labels
Sales preflight UI shows liability tier, estimated counterparty exposure, and suggested concession path
Automatic routing rules created: low-risk SKUs auto-approve contract redlines up to defined thresholds; medium/high escalate to Legal with templated guidance
Pricing experiments can toggle SKU->liability mappings and record conversion/close rate impact
Audit log entries emitted for all contract decisions and visible in Console for 90 days
Integration tests validating mapping, routing, and telemetry across sales -> legal -> billing paths
